1jcuvh2.description_en:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives.
People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.
I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim.
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills.
Seek out and discreetly kill [TARGET] over at [LOCATION].
Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.
Sincerely,
Vaughn
1jcuvh2.description_zh:
首先，请允许我介绍一下我自己。夸张点儿说，我做的是人命的活计。

有人要杀人，就会来找我，而我会雇佣一个完美的杀手。这种方式对所有人来说都安全，因为没有人知道对方是谁，就我们这活儿的性质来说再好不过了。

最近我听说你的手艺不错，能担得起这活儿，这说法到底对不对，我觉得值得一试。

你要是有兴趣给我做事儿，那就展示下你传说中的身手吧。

目标是 [TARGETNAME]，他们在 [LOCATION]，悄悄得杀掉他们。

办成了，你不仅有钱可拿，而且也是你实力的证明，以后还会有活儿给你。

此致，
沃恩

1jg9n3h.description_en:
Hi,
This is Petra Ling, and I’m proud to offer you a new and exciting opportunity to partner with Ling Family Hauling. When my parents started this company, their goal was to provide fast and reliable courier deliveries around the greater Crusader area. It quickly became a success, and as our reputation grew, so did our operations.
Now, under my stewardship, Ling Family Hauling is taking the next big step – cargo hauling. Demand for this new service is growing faster than I expected, and that’s great news for both of us.
If you’ve ever wanted to be a hauler, then I can make your dreams come true. Best way to learn something is by doing it, and I’ve got a haul of [ITEM] that needs to go from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION].
No prior experience is necessary, but here’s a few things to keep in mind. All pick-ups and deliveries must be done at a freight elevator or autoloaded. You will need a ship that can hold 2 SCU cargo containers, and a handheld tractor beam to move them around.
Upon successful completion of this delivery, you will be promoted to a ‘trusted contractor’ status and more hauls will become available to you.
Sincerely,
Petra Ling
Managing Director of Cargo Operations
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
1jg9n3h.description_zh:
嗨，

我是佩特拉·玲，很荣幸能为你提供与玲家快递合作的新机会。我爸妈当初开这家公司，就是想在十字军这一带做又快又稳的快递服务，结果一炮而红，名气越大，生意也越做越大。

现在，在我的管理下，玲家快递即将迈出新的重要一步——开展货运业务。这项新服务的需求增长速度超出了我的预期，这对我们双方来说都是好消息。

如果你一直想从事货运行业，那么这个机会能帮你实现梦想。实践是最好的学习方式，我正好有一单 [ITEM] 需要从 [LOCATION] 运到 [DESTINATION]。

虽然不需要有相关经验，但有以下几点需要注意：所有提货和交付都必须通过货运电梯完成，或者使用自动装载。你需要有一艘能装得下最大 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的飞船，并且需要配备手持式牵引光束来搬运货物。

如果这次运输任务顺利完成，你将被提升为“值得信赖承包商”，之后会有更多的运输任务等着你。


此致，
佩特拉·玲
货运运营总经理
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.
Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near [LOCATION] and likely rearming for another attack.

我们希望你去那里，让他们后悔没有和他们的老帮派一起死去。

40p0yp.description_en:
To all available contractors,
We at Rayari are dedicating all our energy to stopping the regeneration technology crisis in its tracks, but to continue their efforts our scientists need materials that the company's suppliers cannot obtain.
Rayari is seeking an experienced contractor to gather irradiated valakkar fangs, which can be extracted from adult valakkar that have been extensively exposed to radiation. Our scans have uncovered the existence of a qualifying population inside the storm near [LOCATION].
Because these animals are highly dangerous, Rayari is offering premium pay to anyone who can assist with collecting the fangs.
Once attained, please take these valuable resources to [DESTINATION].
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆

临床研究外包

I'm hoping that you'll be able to provide protection services at [LOCATION]. One of our high priority clients is having some real trouble with a band of outlaws targeting their [OBJECTS]. Need to be able to keep the assets as safe and intact as possible. Client’s expecting the service they pay for, so don’t mess this up or we might lose a loyal customer.
For now, we’re still a little in the dark when it comes to these outlaws, but if you manage to nail this to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering 4 MG Scrip to the main contractor.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

目前，关于这些不法分子的情报还比较模糊，但如果您能按照福克斯韦尔的达标标准完成此次任务，我们将向主承包商提供 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为报酬。

祝好运，

尤金·沃尔顿

ndlmmz.description_en:
After weeks of seeing crime rates increase, we’ve been able to identify a sector that we believe to be the source of the outlaw activity that has been leeching into the surrounding areas. While it would be too much to expect to eradicate all threats, we believe that by sending combat patrols into the area we might be able to start reversing this worrisome trend. Our in-house combat analysts recommend bringing around three wingmen in combat-ready ships to confront any hostile forces you might encounter.
Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the location marker on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of 24 MG Scrip.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
ndlmmz.description_zh:
折腾了几个星期，总算摸清了那帮不法分子的老巢，就藏在最近闹得最凶的那片星域。想彻底清干净是没戏，但咱派巡逻队杀过去，也许能压一压这股邪风。我们内部的战斗分析员建议你带上三架僚机，开艘能硬刚的船以对抗你可能遇到的任何敌对势力。

接了这活儿，飞到 HUD 上标出的位置标记，把沿途所有航路点都扫一遍。等全搞定，主承包商额外奖励[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

1b73xq1.description_en:
Hi,
Got a relatively straightforward one for you if you're interested.
One of our pilot ignored a maintenance warning and sure enough, a couple of hours later their ship broke down over at [LOCATION]. They're on their way back to the office now but we could do with a reliable hauler whose got a ship big enough to transport [MAX_SCU] cargo containers to complete the haul for us.
Think you could help us out? You just need to pick up the stranded shipment and deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. And I probably don't have to say this, but a heavy-duty tractor beam would probably be handy to have along.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
1b73xq1.description_zh:
嗨，

有个挺简单的活儿，你要是有兴趣的话。

我们一个飞行员没当回事，直接无视了维护警报，结果几小时后，飞船真在 [LOCATION] 那儿抛锚了。人现在正回办公室路上，但我们需要个靠谱的运输员，开艘能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱 的大船，帮我们把这趟货拉完。

你觉得能搭把手不？先去把滞留的货取走，再送到 [DESTINATION] 那儿的货运电梯就行。我猜不用多说你也知道，带个重型牵引光束肯定更方便。

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

13k1hl5.description_en:
We were a little too smart with this one and it’s kinda backfired. Sometimes you gotta dream big, you know? Anyway. we were looking to move some encrypted data to one of our data havens and decided to hide it in a ship’s blackbox. They filled the ship with “valuable” stuff as a decoy in case it got attacked. The plan worked a little too well and the cargo might have attracted the wrong kind of attention. They stole all the cargo but missed the blackbox. Bad news is the ship is now swarming with outlaws.
The data on that blackbox is useless to them, but we need it. If you can get it back for us, we can give you a nice cut from what we make. Seems like a fair deal, right?
Head to [LOCATION] and after you’ve done your thing take the flight recorder to [DESTINATION].
-Bit Zeros
13k1hl5.description_zh:
这次我们自作聪明，结果翻车了。人嘛，总得有点梦想对吧？我们本来想把一批加密数据藏进飞船黑匣子，运到咱们的数据据点。为了骗过敌人，还特意在船上堆满“值钱货”当诱饵。结果这招太灵了——东西是唬住人了，可也引来了不该来的人。货全被抢光了，唯独漏了黑匣子。坏消息是，现在那艘船周围全是不法分子，跟蜂窝似的。

那黑匣子里的数据对他们屁用没有，但我们非得拿回来。你要是能帮我们搞到手，分你一大笔，这买卖不亏吧？

去 [LOCATION] 把事儿办了，然后把飞行记录仪送到 [DESTINATION]。

- 零比特
